# twenty_field

Reads field metadata without changing it, including built-in fields and complex types unsupported by the field resource. A lookup by `field_id` needs no settings permission. A lookup by `object_id` and `name` also reads object metadata and requires `DATA_MODEL`.

Specify `field_id` alone, or both `object_id` and `name`. UUID comparisons ignore case. Names match exactly within the selected object, across every page; missing or ambiguous names produce errors. A UUID lookup also returns the field's parent object UUID and name.

## Example usage

```terraform
data "twenty_object" "company" {
  name_singular = "company"
}

data "twenty_field" "company_name" {
  object_id = data.twenty_object.company.id
  name      = "name"
}

# Alternatively, specify field_id alone with the native field UUID.
```

Use the [field resource](../resources/field.md) to manage supported custom fields. This data source does not read CRM records or export field defaults, options, or relationships.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `field_id` (String) Native field UUID. Cannot be combined with object_id or name.
- `name` (String) Exact, case-sensitive field name within object_id. Supply with object_id, or read it from a field_id lookup.
- `object_id` (String) Parent object UUID. Supply with name, or read it from a field_id lookup.

### Read-Only

- `application_id` (String) UUID of the application that owns this field.
- `description` (String) Description, or null when absent.
- `icon` (String) Icon identifier, or null when absent.
- `id` (String) Native UUID of the matching field.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the field is active.
- `is_system` (Boolean) Whether Twenty marks this field as system metadata.
- `label` (String) Display label.
- `type` (String) Twenty field type, including types unsupported by the field resource.
